svg.text: DDR ground coverage replaces 13 blind pad vias
Actual exported GND copper minus actual drills · fixed processor and DDR placement · verified native and exported connectivity
Pad vias with an actual surface path to a through GND barrel; 0.1 mm neck screen also passes.
Display geometry simplified to 2 µm; full geometry is checked. SI/PI and current capacity are unqualified. All 416 GND component terminals remain connected after actual drilling.
